section.title: Crash analysis
section.empty: No crash records yet. When the game client crashes, WoWSP catches it here and prepares an analysis.

findings.exceptionAccessViolation: Access violation — the client read or wrote memory it does not own
findings.exceptionStackBufferOverrun: Stack buffer overrun — a local buffer was written past its end
findings.exceptionStackOverflow: Stack overflow — the call stack outgrew its limit (often recursive plugin code)
findings.exceptionHeapCorruption: Heap corruption — the process heap was already damaged before the crash
findings.exceptionIllegalInstruction: Illegal instruction — the CPU received a code sequence it cannot execute
findings.exceptionPrivilegedInstruction: Privileged instruction — a kernel-only CPU instruction ran in user mode
findings.exceptionDllInitFailed: DLL initialization failed — a library's entry point returned failure
findings.exceptionDllNotFound: DLL not found — a required library is missing
findings.evidenceEventLog: Found in the Windows event log
findings.gameLogErrors: {count} error line(s) in the game log
findings.modsActiveAtCrash: Plugins were active when the client crashed
findings.safeModeOn: Safe mode was on — the stock client crashed without plugins
findings.probeWasActive: The WoWSP in-game probe was active
findings.dumpAvailable: A crash dump is available for deep analysis
findings.danglingUiReference: Dangling UI reference — the crash log shows "{url}" failing to load while a mod file still asks for it

errors.gameRunning: The game client is running — close it before restarting or switching safe mode.

safeguard.title: Crash detection & safety net
safeguard.hint: While enabled, WoWSP watches for game crashes and parses recent crash evidence — including crashes that happened while WoWSP was closed.
